subject: MSA & Order Form — press/publicity clauses and audit trail

Cc: Acme Legal <legal@acmecloud.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: MSA + Order Form: publicity & confidentiality — audit trail request

Hi David —

Thanks for sending the updated Order Form. Our legal team has one outstanding item on the publicity / reference rights section (Order Form sec. 7) and a related ask about keeping an auditable trail of approvals for press and logo use. Specifically:

- We want clarity that any public announcement referencing Acme Cloud requires prior written approval from our comms team (we usually manage via email or a signed approval PDF).
- Can Redwood retain an immutable audit log of approval activity (who approved, timestamp, the asset approved) for compliance reviews? If so, what is the proposed retention period and who in Redwood can access those logs?

I've attached our redline of the Order Form (Redline_OrderForm_v3.pdf) for your reference. Legal is open to narrow language but we need a clear sign-off matrix and a retention clause in the MSA or Order Form.

Would appreciate if you can loop in your legal ops and counsel so we can get a final bit of text to attach to the Order Form.

Best,
Jenna Collins
Head of Partnerships
Acme Cloud

Attachments: Redline_OrderForm_v3.pdf

Jenna — thanks for the clear note and the redline. Looping in Laura and Kimberly so we can get a legally approved text block and confirm audit/log retention. A couple quick clarifying questions from a process perspective: 

1) When Acme says "prior written approval," do you need a DocuSign signature on each asset, or is an archived approval email from your comms lead sufficient?
2) Do you have a minimum retention period required by your internal compliance (e.g., 24 months, 36 months)?

Internal to team: can Legal propose a concise provision that we can insert into sec. 7 (Publicity / Reference) and add an Appendix A signoff matrix that lists roles authorized to approve? Also want to capture required fields in the audit entry (approver name, role, timestamp, asset id, approved copy).

I'll coordinate and get back to you with an update by end of day.

Thanks —

From: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: david.kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, laura.bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 Jun 2029 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed redline language for publicity & audit log (for ACME review)

David / Laura —

Below is a proposed insertion for Order Form sec. 7 (Publicity / Reference) plus a short audit-log retention clause. I kept the language narrow to preserve Acme's control while giving Redwood the ability to operate our approvals workflow. Please review and we can send this back to Jenna.

--- PROPOSED REDLINE ---
7. Publicity and Reference Rights. Neither party shall make any public announcement, press release, or otherwise publicize the existence of the business relationship, use of the other party's name, or logos, without the prior written consent of the other party. "Prior written consent" may be satisfied by: (a) an executed DocuSign approval specific to the asset being published; or (b) a confirmed email from the other party's authorized communications representative specified in Appendix A.

Appendix A (Signoff Matrix): lists authorized approvers for Acme Cloud (name + role + email) and for Redwood (name + role + email).

Audit Log and Retention. Redwood will maintain an immutable audit log of publicity approvals (audit entries to include approver identity, approver role, timestamp, the approved asset, and approval method). Audit logs will be retained for thirty-six (36) months and will be accessible to Acme upon written request for the purposes of audit or compliance review; such access shall be governed by Redwood's standard data access process and subject to confidentiality protections set forth in the MSA.

--- END PROPOSED REDLINE ---

Notes: 
- 36 months for audit logs is conservative and aligns with our internal retention for compliance artifacts. If Acme prefers 24 months we can offer that as a compromise.
- If we include DocuSign as an acceptable approval method, we should attach a DocuSign workflow link to the Order Form.

Attached: proposed_redlines.docx (inline markups).

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel | Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_redlines.docx

From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Jenna Collins <jenna.collins@acmecloud.com>; David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: kimberly_park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, rishi_malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 16 Jun 2029 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MSA + Order Form: publicity & confidentiality — audit trail request

Hi Jenna —

Thanks for the redline and Kimberly for the suggested text. We've updated the Order Form and included Appendix A (Signoff Matrix) with placeholders for Acme approvers. Summary of changes and process: 

- Publicity language: we will use the proposed insertion; it requires either a DocuSign signature or a confirmed email from an authorized comms contact.
- Audit log retention: set to thirty-six (36) months for audit entries (approver, role, timestamp, asset id, approval copy).
- Data access: Acme can request audit extracts for compliance reviews; requests will route through Redwood Legal Ops (laura.bennett@redwood.ai) and we will provide extracts over a secure channel.
- Internal controls: audit logs are write-once, stored encrypted, and access-controlled; only Legal Ops and Compliance have export privileges unless a specific export is requested by the customer and approved.

Link to revised Order Form (attached) and a staging DocuSign envelope to capture approvals: https://docusign.com/embeddedSign/abc123

Next steps for Acme: please confirm whether an archived approval email is sufficient or you prefer DocuSign for all assets. Also, please provide the list of authorized approvers to populate Appendix A. Once we have that we can finalize and send the Order Form for signature.

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Legal Operations Lead | Redwood Inference

Attachments: orderform_v5.pdf

Laura / David —

Thanks — this looks good and reasonable. A few quick replies: 

- DocuSign is preferred for formal marketing materials, but an archived approval email is acceptable for short-form quotes or social posts as long as it includes the approver name, role, and explicit reference to the asset.
- Acme compliance prefers a 36 month audit trail for partner publicity approvals where possible; that aligns with Kimberly's suggestion.
- We'll send the list of authorized approvers by EOD Monday.

One last question from our comms team: for co-branded assets, can Redwood provide a single-permit checkbox in the DocuSign flow confirming Acme's logo usage guidelines were followed? If so, we'll want that recorded in the audit entry.

If that's the only ask, we can proceed to signature once Appendix A is populated. 

Best,
Jenna Collins
Head of Partnerships | Acme Cloud
